items.q: Does Dalio agree we are in an AI bubble?
items.a: Yes on **classic signs**, as a **degree**, not binary. AI is revolutionary (**body then mind**), but price still matters. **Wealth ≠ money**: paper net worth is not cash. Leverage on inflated collateral reverses when rates/taxes force sales.

items.q: What is the ~80-year frame around the bubble?
items.a: The **big cycle**: debt/money, domestic political conflict, and geopolitics peaking together. Don't try to time the top — even pros struggle. Build months→years of security first.

sections.title: What to hold, what to become

items.q: How does he want personal finance positioned?
items.a: **Diversified all-weather**: stocks, bonds, house, gold, Bitcoin. Cash is a long-term loser (inflation + tax on interest). Hard-money sleeve **~5–15%**; he prefers **gold**, holds ~**1% BTC** (privacy, reserve asset, not someone else's liability).

**Adaptability over job prediction.** Happiness/health above max income; make work and passion the same; maximize AI tools + usefulness rather than betting one title. Unemployment spikes from **bubble burst + debt unwind**, not only from tech.
